scope: Four new real-source fixed-element distillation/mapping cases. Not retrieval, extraction, classification, decomposition or product accuracy.
scoring: Directional expectations require the exact relationship. Context expectations reject directional claims; missing context is separately counted.

cases.title: PostgreSQL 18 Serialization Failure Handling
elements: A serialization failure requires retrying the complete PostgreSQL transaction, including the logic deciding which SQL to issue.
supports
Retrying a failed PostgreSQL transaction guarantees completion on the next attempt.
challenges
A retried PostgreSQL transaction finishes within one millisecond.
context

cases.title: USGS: Can you predict earthquakes?
elements: USGS can calculate the probability of a significant earthquake in an area over a number of years.
supports
USGS can currently predict the exact date, location and magnitude of a future major earthquake.
challenges
A significant earthquake will occur in London tomorrow.
context

cases.title: NASA: What Causes the Seasons?
elements: Earth's axial tilt causes its seasons.
supports
Northern Hemisphere summer occurs because Earth is closest to the Sun then.
challenges
London will have a temperature of 25 degrees Celsius tomorrow.
context

cases.title: NOAA: Weather versus Climate
elements: Climate describes weather over a long period in a particular area.
supports
An area's Climate Normals provide specific details of the weather on any given day.
challenges
Rain will fall in London tomorrow.
context
